patterns.note: Dominant use of full-bleed, high-impact imagery and video as background elements for hero sections and major content blocks, often with large text overlays.
Headings are consistently oversized, bold, and often in all-caps, creating a strong visual hierarchy and impact against smaller, legible body text.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is foundational, accented by vibrant blues, reds, and other product-specific colors within the rich photography and video content.
The primary navigation bar at the top of the page transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Hero sections utilize a carousel system (swiper) to display full-bleed imagery or video, often with large text overlays and calls to action.
Content sections below the fold are revealed with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience.
Repeated use of horizontal scrollable carousels for showcasing product collections or featured athletes, providing a dynamic browsing experience.

technique_notes: The site employs a dynamic sticky header that reduces its height and transitions from transparent to a solid white background as the user scrolls. Hero sections leverage a 'swiper' carousel component for full-bleed background videos or images, often with large, impactful text overlays. Further down the page, content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered 'css-keyframes' animations, typically a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect, as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, all-caps headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual impact, contrasted with smaller, legible body and label text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; very slight rounding on buttons and some image containers, but mostly sharp edges for images and content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; hero sections are very airy, while product grids and text sections maintain a balanced density with clear vertical rhythm between major content blocks.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its relentless focus on aspirational, full-bleed photography and video, paired with monumental typography that makes each section feel like a high-impact editorial spread. It prioritizes visual storytelling and brand immersion over dense information, creating a dynamic and emotionally resonant browsing experience.
